prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Windows desktop app icon for Touhou WASD, a keyboard remapper for Touhou Project.
Primary request: Create one polished, distinctive icon combining a keyboard keycap and a crimson/ivory yin-yang orb evocative of Touhou.
Subject: A single nearly front-facing rounded-square graphite keycap with a large, instantly readable classic red-and-warm-white yin-yang emblem centered on its face. The two small contrasting yin-yang dots must be clear. A shallow lower keycap lip subtly communicates a physical keyboard key.
Style/medium: Premium restrained 2.5D desktop icon, clean vector-like silhouette, broad simple forms, precise curved edges, subtle soft bevel and restrained material highlights, contemporary utility app aesthetic.
Composition/framing: One centered icon only, square canvas, the key fills about 88% of the canvas. Nearly orthographic front view with only a slight view of the bottom keycap lip. Generous smooth corner radii. Emblem is large and high contrast, legible at 16–32 pixels.
Color palette: Deep graphite keycap, rich vermilion red, warm ivory white.
Scene/backdrop: Genuine transparent background outside the keycap, no background tile or scenery.
Constraints: No words, no letters, no typography, no watermark, no extra objects, no app mockup, no display stand, no multiple variations, no fine decorative lines. Preserve a bold clean silhouette and transparent exterior.
